# Carousel — full implementation guide

This document is the detailed companion to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md). It covers architecture, markup, configuration, full examples, testing, and troubleshooting.

## Portable source files (copy into other projects)

All carousel runtime sources are vendored next to this guide:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [reference/carousel.js](reference/carousel.js) | `initializeCarousel`, `renderCarouselContainer`, etc. |
| [reference/shared-debounce.js](reference/shared-debounce.js) | Dependency of `carousel.js` (standalone bundle; in-repo carousel uses `scripts/utility/shared.js`) |
| [reference/_carousel.scss](reference/_carousel.scss) | Layout, scroll, grid/carousel mode |
| [reference/_block-padding.scss](reference/_block-padding.scss) | Padding mixin used with carousel blocks |

Keep `carousel.js` and `shared-debounce.js` **in the same directory** if you use the bundled import.

---

## Overview

The shared carousel system provides a reusable, responsive carousel component for EDS blocks. It automatically adapts between grid and carousel modes based on item count and viewport breakpoint, following GEL design standards.

**Location in this repo**: `scripts/utility/carousel.js`, `styles/components/_carousel.scss`, `styles/mixins/_block-padding.scss`

**Location in this skill package**: [reference/](reference/) (same files; `carousel.js` imports `./shared-debounce.js` here)

**Used by**: `action-card`, `cards`, `tap-tiles` blocks

---

## Key Concepts

### Carousel vs Grid Mode

- **Grid mode**: Items displayed in a responsive grid layout (not scrollable)
- **Carousel mode**: Items displayed in a horizontally scrollable container with navigation controls
- **Automatic switching**: The system determines which mode to use based on:
  - Number of items in the block
  - Current viewport breakpoint
  - Optional stacked override

### Breakpoint Thresholds

The carousel uses GEL breakpoints with configurable item count thresholds:

| Breakpoint | Min Width | Default Threshold | Description |
|------------|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| `xs`       | 0px       | 2+ items          | Mobile portrait |
| `xsl`      | 576px     | 2+ items          | Mobile landscape |
| `sm`       | 768px     | 3+ items          | Tablet |
| `md`       | 992px     | 3+ items          | Desktop |
| `lg`       | 1200px    | 4+ items          | Wide desktop |
| `xl`       | 1584px    | 5+ items          | Ultra-wide |

**Threshold Logic**: If item count >= threshold, carousel mode activates. Otherwise, grid mode is used.

### Grid Column Spans

Each carousel item's width is calculated based on how many grid columns it should span:

| Breakpoint | Default Span | % of 12-col grid |
|------------|--------------|------------------|
| `xs`       | 10 columns   | ~83%             |
| `xsl`      | 10 columns   | ~83%             |
| `sm`       | 5 columns    | ~42%             |
| `md`       | 4 columns    | ~33%             |
| `lg`       | 4 columns    | ~33%             |
| `xl`       | 3 columns    | 25%              |

The system automatically calculates pixel width from column spans, accounting for:
- Responsive padding (12px → 72px based on breakpoint)
- Gutter spacing between columns (12px → 24px)
- Maximum content width (1584px)

---

## Architecture

### HTML Structure

```html
<div class="block action-card">
  <!-- Block header (optional) -->
  <div class="block-header">...</div>
  
  <!-- Carousel container (generated by renderCarouselContainer) -->
  <div class="carousel-block-container action-card-block-container">
    <!-- Row 1: Scrollable list -->
    <div class="carousel-list action-card-row-1">
      <div class="carousel-list-padding action-card-list-padding">
        <ul class="action-card-list" role="list" tabindex="0">
          <li class="carousel-item action-card-item">...</li>
          <li class="carousel-item action-card-item">...</li>
          <!-- More items -->
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Row 2: Scrollbar + navigation (shown in carousel mode only) -->
    <div class="carousel-row-2 action-card-row-2">
      <div class="carousel-scrollbar-container">
        <div class="carousel-scrollbar">
          <div class="carousel-scrollbar-thumb"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="carousel-controls">
        <button class="carousel-scroll-btn carousel-scroll-prev" aria-label="Scroll left">
          <i class="gel-icon gel-icon-arrow-left gel-icon-md" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        </button>
        <button class="carousel-scroll-btn carousel-scroll-next" aria-label="Scroll right">
          <i class="gel-icon gel-icon-arrow-right gel-icon-md" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Key Structure Notes**:
- `.carousel-list` (parent) is the scroll container - NO padding on this element
- `.carousel-list-padding` (child) has responsive padding
- Padding on child creates scrollable overflow in parent, allowing left and right padding zones to be scrollable
- `.carousel-row-2` is hidden in grid mode, shown in carousel mode via CSS

### Class Naming Convention

All carousel elements use **dual class naming**:
1. **Generic carousel class** (e.g., `carousel-list`) - shared styles from `_carousel.scss`
2. **Block-specific class** (e.g., `action-card-list`) - block-specific overrides

This allows:
- Shared carousel functionality via generic classes
- Block-specific styling via prefixed classes
- No conflicts between blocks

---

## Implementation Steps

**Imports:** Blocks use `import … from '../../scripts/utility/carousel.js'` (paths vary by block depth). When you copy only the skill bundle, import from your copy of [reference/carousel.js](reference/carousel.js) next to [reference/shared-debounce.js](reference/shared-debounce.js).

### Step 1: Import Carousel Utilities

```javascript
import {
  initializeCarousel,
  renderCarouselContainer,
} from '../../scripts/utility/carousel.js';
```

### Step 2: Render Carousel HTML

In your `renderHTML()` function, use `renderCarouselContainer()`:

```javascript
/**
 * @param {string} prefix - Block-specific prefix (e.g., 'action-card', 'tap-tiles')
 * @param {string} itemsHTML - HTML string for list items
 * @param {Object} [options={}] - Configuration options
 * @param {boolean} [options.isStacked=false] - Whether to disable carousel (force grid mode)
 * @returns {string} HTML string for carousel container
 */
renderCarouselContainer(prefix, itemsHTML, options)
```

**Example (action-card)**:
```javascript
function renderHTML(data) {
  const cardsHTML = data.cards
    .map(card => `
      <li class="carousel-item action-card-item">
        <div class="action-card">
          <h3>${card.heading}</h3>
        </div>
      </li>
    `)
    .join('');

  return `
    ${headingHTML}
    ${renderCarouselContainer('action-card', cardsHTML, { isStacked: false })}
  `;
}
```

**Important**: Each list item MUST have the class `carousel-item` for carousel functionality to work.

### Step 3: Initialize Carousel

In your `decorate()` function, call `initializeCarousel()` after DOM is updated:

```javascript
/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} block - The block element
 * @param {number} itemCount - Number of items in carousel
 * @param {Object} [options={}] - Configuration options (all optional)
 * @param {boolean} [options.isStacked=false] - Disable carousel (stacked layout)
 * @param {boolean} [options.equalizeHeights=false] - Equalize item heights
 * @param {Object} [options.carouselThresholds] - Custom thresholds
 * @param {Object} [options.carouselItemSpans] - Custom item column spans
 * @param {boolean} [options.canCarouselItemGrow=false] - Allow items to grow beyond span width
 */
initializeCarousel(block, itemCount, options)
```

**Example (action-card with defaults)**:
```javascript
export default function decorate(block) {
  const data = extractData(block);
  block.innerHTML = renderHTML(data);
  
  // Move instrumentation...
  decorateIcons(block);
  
  if (data.cards.length > 0) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      initializeCarousel(block, data.cards.length, {
        isStacked: false,
        equalizeHeights: true,
      });
    });
  }
}
```

**Why `requestAnimationFrame`?**
- Ensures carousel initializes after browser has painted the DOM
- Allows accurate height/width measurements
- Prevents visual flashing

---

## Configuration Options

### Default Configuration (action-card, card)

```javascript
initializeCarousel(block, itemCount, {
  isStacked: false,           // Enable carousel mode
  equalizeHeights: true,      // Make all cards same height
});
```

**Thresholds used** (defaults):
```javascript
{
  xl: 5,  // 1584px+: 5+ items = carousel
  lg: 4,  // 1200px+: 4+ items = carousel
  md: 3,  // 992px+: 3+ items = carousel
  sm: 3,  // 768px+: 3+ items = carousel
  xsl: 2, // 576px+: 2+ items = carousel
  xs: 2,  // <576px: 2+ items = carousel
}
```

**Column spans used** (defaults):
```javascript
{
  xl: 3,   // 1584px+: 3 columns (25% width)
  lg: 4,   // 1200px+: 4 columns (33% width)
  md: 4,   // 992px+: 4 columns (33% width)
  sm: 5,   // 768px+: 5 columns (42% width)
  xsl: 10, // 576px+: 10 columns (83% width)
  xs: 10,  // <576px: 10 columns (83% width)
}
```

### Custom Configuration (tap-tiles)

For blocks requiring different behavior, provide custom thresholds and spans:

```javascript
initializeCarousel(block, data.tiles.length, {
  isStacked: data.stackTiles,  // Respect stacked class
  equalizeHeights: false,       // Don't equalize heights
  carouselThresholds: {
    xl: 7,   // 1584px+: 7+ items = carousel
    lg: 7,   // 1200px+: 7+ items = carousel
    md: 6,   // 992px+: 6+ items = carousel
    sm: 5,   // 768px+: 5+ items = carousel
    xsl: 3,  // 576px+: 3+ items = carousel
    xs: 3,   // <576px: 3+ items = carousel
  },
  carouselItemSpans: {
    xl: 2,    // 1584px+: 2 columns (~16.7% width)
    lg: 2,    // 1200px+: 2 columns (~16.7% width)
    md: 2.4,  // 992px+: 2.4 columns (20% width)
    sm: 3,    // 768px+: 3 columns (25% width)
    xsl: 5.2, // 576px+: 5.2 columns (~43% width)
    xs: 5.2,  // <576px: 5.2 columns (~43% width)
  },
  canCarouselItemGrow: true, // Allow items to grow to fill space
});
```

**When to customize**:
- Block has narrower items (tap-tiles: 2 columns vs action-card: 3 columns)
- Block needs higher thresholds (tap-tiles: 7 items on xl vs 5 for action-card)
- Block should always show grid (set `isStacked: true`)

## Styling

### SCSS Import

Import shared carousel styles in your block SCSS:

```scss
@use '../../styles/variables' as *;
@use '../../styles/mixins/block-padding' as *;

// Block-specific styles...

.my-block {
  @include block-padding;
}

// Carousel styles are automatically included via _carousel.scss
// No additional import needed - styles apply via generic classes
```

**Note**: The carousel layout (flexbox, scrolling, wrapping, padding, stacked behavior) is automatically handled by `styles/components/_carousel.scss`. You only need to style the visual appearance of your block and items.

### Block-Specific Styling

Focus on styling your block container and items. The carousel system handles everything else:

**Note** : Below styles are just for a reference. Actual styles might be different based on the requirements.
```scss
// Container - optional positioning/styling only
.my-block-block-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// Item wrapper - essential flexbox properties
.my-block-item {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0; // Essential for flexbox truncation
  position: relative; // For absolute positioned children
}

// Link/content - your custom visual styles
.my-block-link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: spacing(4);
  background: var(--surface-pale-faint);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-muted-soft);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--text-body);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: box-shadow $carousel-transition, transform $carousel-transition;

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--surface-primary);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}
```

**What you DON'T need to style**:
- ❌ `.carousel-mode` toggling - handled automatically
- ❌ Grid vs carousel layout - handled by `_carousel.scss`
- ❌ Item widths/spans - calculated by `carousel.js`
- ❌ Flex wrapping in grid mode - handled by `_carousel.scss`
- ❌ Scrollbar/navigation visibility - handled by `_carousel.scss`
- ❌ Carousel list padding - handled by `_block-padding.scss`

## Complete Examples

### Example 1: Default Configuration (Most Common)

Use this for standard blocks with typical card sizes (3-4 columns width).

#### JavaScript (blocks/my-block/my-block.js)

```javascript
import { decorateIcons } from '../../scripts/aem.js';
import { moveInstrumentation } from '../../scripts/scripts.js';
import {
  renderBlockHeader,
  getCellText,
  getCellUrl,
  getFirstCell,
} from '../../scripts/utility/shared.js';
import {
  initializeCarousel,
  renderCarouselContainer,
} from '../../scripts/utility/carousel.js';

// =============================================================================
// Data Extraction
// =============================================================================

function extractItemFromRow(row) {
  const cells = [...row.children];
  if (cells.length < 2) return null;

  return {
    label: getCellText(cells[0]) || '',
    url: getCellUrl(cells[1]) || '',
    row, // Keep reference for moveInstrumentation
  };
}

function extractData(block) {
  const rows = [...block.children];
  
  const data = {
    heading: getCellText(getFirstCell(rows[0])) || '',
    items: [],
  };

  // Extract items from rows 1+
  data.items = rows
    .slice(1)
    .map(extractItemFromRow)
    .filter(Boolean);

  return data;
}

// =============================================================================
// Render
// =============================================================================

function renderHTML(data) {
  const { heading, items } = data;

  const headingHTML = heading
    ? renderBlockHeader({ heading, hideHeading: false, headingLevel: 'h2' })
    : '';

  const itemsHTML = items
    .map(item => `
      <li class="carousel-item my-block-item">
        <a href="${item.url}" class="my-block-link">
          <span class="my-block-label">${item.label}</span>
        </a>
      </li>
    `)
    .join('');

  return `
    ${headingHTML}
    ${renderCarouselContainer('my-block', itemsHTML, { isStacked: false })}
  `;
}

// =============================================================================
// Main Decorate Function
// =============================================================================

export default function decorate(block) {
  // Prevent double decoration
  if (block.querySelector('.my-block-block-container')) {
    return;
  }

  // 1. Extract data
  const data = extractData(block);

  // 2. Render HTML
  const authoredRows = data.items.map(item => item.row);
  block.innerHTML = renderHTML(data);

  // 3. Move Universal Editor instrumentation
  const renderedItems = block.querySelectorAll('.my-block-item');
  renderedItems.forEach((renderedItem, index) => {
    const authoredRow = authoredRows[index];
    if (authoredRow) {
      moveInstrumentation(authoredRow, renderedItem);
    }
  });

  // 4. Decorate icons (if using GEL icons)
  decorateIcons(block);

  // 5. Initialize carousel with DEFAULT configuration
  if (data.items.length > 0) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      initializeCarousel(block, data.items.length, {
        isStacked: false,        // Enable carousel mode
        equalizeHeights: true,   // Make all items same height
      });
      // Uses default thresholds: { xl: 5, lg: 4, md: 3, sm: 3, xsl: 2, xs: 2 }
      // Uses default spans: { xl: 3, lg: 4, md: 4, sm: 5, xsl: 10, xs: 10 }
    });
  }
}
```

#### SCSS (blocks/my-block/my-block.scss)

```scss
@use '../../styles/variables' as *;
@use '../../styles/mixins/block-padding' as *;

// =============================================================================
// Block Container
// =============================================================================

.my-block {
  @include block-padding;
}

// =============================================================================
// Container & Items
// =============================================================================

.my-block-block-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

.my-block-item {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  position: relative;
}

.my-block-link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: spacing(4);
  background: var(--surface-pale-faint);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-muted-soft);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--text-body);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: box-shadow $carousel-transition, transform $carousel-transition;

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--surface-primary);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
}

.my-block-label {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.5;

// =============================================================================

  .my-block {
    background: var(--background-white-pale);
```

### Example 2: Custom Configuration (Narrow Items)

Use this for blocks with narrower items (2-3 columns width) that need different thresholds.

#### JavaScript (blocks/narrow-block/narrow-block.js)

```javascript
// ...same imports and extraction functions as Example 1...

export default function decorate(block) {
  if (block.querySelector('.narrow-block-block-container')) {
    return;
  }

  const data = extractData(block);
  const authoredRows = data.items.map(item => item.row);
  block.innerHTML = renderHTML(data);

  const renderedItems = block.querySelectorAll('.narrow-block-item');
  renderedItems.forEach((renderedItem, index) => {
    const authoredRow = authoredRows[index];
    if (authoredRow) {
      moveInstrumentation(authoredRow, renderedItem);
    }
  });

  decorateIcons(block);

  // Initialize carousel with CUSTOM configuration
  if (data.items.length > 0) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      initializeCarousel(block, data.items.length, {
        isStacked: false,
        equalizeHeights: false, // Don't equalize heights (optional)
        // Custom thresholds - more items needed for carousel due to narrower items
        carouselThresholds: {
          xl: 7,   // 1584px+: 7+ items = carousel
          lg: 7,   // 1200px+: 7+ items = carousel
          md: 6,   // 992px+: 6+ items = carousel
          sm: 5,   // 768px+: 5+ items = carousel
          xsl: 3,  // 576px+: 3+ items = carousel
          xs: 3,   // <576px: 3+ items = carousel
        },
        // Custom spans - narrower items (2-3 columns vs default 3-4)
        carouselItemSpans: {
          xl: 2,    // 1584px+: 2 columns (~16.7% width)
          lg: 2,    // 1200px+: 2 columns (~16.7% width)
          md: 2.4,  // 992px+: 2.4 columns (20% width)
          sm: 3,    // 768px+: 3 columns (25% width)
          xsl: 5.2, // 576px+: 5.2 columns (~43% width)
          xs: 5.2,  // <576px: 5.2 columns (~43% width)
        },
        canCarouselItemGrow: true, // Allow items to grow to fill space
      });
    });
  }
}
```

### Configuration Comparison

| Aspect | Default (Example 1) | Custom (Example 2) |
|--------|--------------------|--------------------|
| **Use Case** | Standard cards (action-card, card) | Narrow items (tap-tiles) |
| **Item Width** | 3-4 columns | 2-3 columns |
| **Thresholds** | 5/4/3/3/2/2 | 7/7/6/5/3/3 |
| **Column Spans** | 3/4/4/5/10/10 | 2/2/2.4/3/5.2/5.2 |
| **Equalize Heights** | Yes (typically) | No (typically) |
| **Can Grow** | No | Yes |

**When to use custom configuration:**
- ✅ Items are narrower than 3 columns (e.g., tap tiles, small buttons)
- ✅ Need higher item count before carousel activates
- ✅ Items should grow to fill available space
- ✅ Heights should not be equalized (variable content)

**When to use default configuration:**
- ✅ Standard card sizes (3-4 columns wide)
- ✅ Consistent item heights desired
- ✅ Typical carousel behavior is sufficient

---

## Testing Checklist

When implementing carousel in a new block, verify:

### Functionality
- [ ] Grid mode displays at low item counts (below threshold)
- [ ] Carousel mode activates at high item counts (at/above threshold)
- [ ] Navigation buttons work (scroll left/right)
- [ ] Navigation buttons disable at scroll boundaries
- [ ] Scrollbar thumb reflects scroll position
- [ ] Scrollbar thumb is draggable
- [ ] Clicking scrollbar track scrolls appropriately
- [ ] Responsive behavior works across all breakpoints
- [ ] `isStacked` option forces grid mode when set to `true`

### Accessibility
- [ ] Carousel list has `tabindex="0"` (keyboard scrollable)
- [ ] Navigation buttons have descriptive `aria-label`
- [ ] Focus states visible on buttons and list
- [ ] Keyboard arrow keys scroll the list when focused
- [ ] Screen reader announces item count and navigation

### Visual/UX
- [ ] Items have consistent spacing (gap)
- [ ] Padding matches GEL standards (12px → 72px)
- [ ] Hover effects work in carousel mode
- [ ] Scrollbar is hidden in grid mode
- [ ] No visual flashing on page load
- [ ] Dark mode styles apply correctly
- [ ] Height equalization works (if enabled)

### Universal Editor
- [ ] Instrumentation preserved on carousel items
- [ ] Items editable in Universal Editor
- [ ] Adding/removing items updates carousel correctly

## Troubleshooting

### Carousel Not Activating

**Symptom**: Items always show in grid mode, never carousel

**Causes**:
1. Item count below threshold for current breakpoint
2. `isStacked: true` passed to `initializeCarousel()`
3. Missing `carousel-item` class on list items
4. Missing `.carousel-block-container` in HTML

**Solution**:
- Check item count vs threshold table above
- Verify `isStacked` is `false` or omitted
- Ensure each `<li>` has `carousel-item` class
- Verify `renderCarouselContainer()` is used

### Items Not Scrolling

**Symptom**: Carousel mode active but items don't scroll

**Causes**:
1. Padding applied to `.carousel-list` instead of `.carousel-list-padding`
2. Missing `overflow-x: auto` on `.carousel-list`
3. Items not wide enough to cause overflow

**Solution**:
- Verify padding is on `.carousel-list-padding` (child), not `.carousel-list` (parent)
- Check that `.carousel-list` has `overflow-x: auto` from `_carousel.scss`
- Verify item widths are calculated correctly (check DevTools)

### Navigation Buttons Always Disabled

**Symptom**: Prev/Next buttons are always disabled

**Causes**:
1. Scroll container width equals or exceeds content width
2. Items not rendering at expected widths
3. `updateScrollButtons()` not being called

**Solution**:
- Inspect `.carousel-list` scrollWidth vs clientWidth in DevTools
- Verify carousel item spans are configured correctly
- Check browser console for JavaScript errors

### Heights Not Equalizing

**Symptom**: `equalizeHeights: true` but items have different heights

**Causes**:
1. ResizeObserver not triggering
2. Images loading after initialization
3. Dynamic content changing heights

**Solution**:
- Verify `equalizeHeights: true` is passed to `initializeCarousel()`
- Use `loading="eager"` on images in carousel
- Call `requestAnimationFrame()` before initializing

### Scrollbar Not Visible

**Symptom**: Carousel works but scrollbar missing

**Causes**:
1. `.carousel-row-2` hidden by CSS
2. `renderCarouselControls()` not called
3. Carousel mode not activated

**Solution**:
- Check that `.carousel-mode` class is added to `.carousel-block-container`
- Verify `renderCarouselContainer()` includes controls
- Inspect CSS - `.carousel-row-2` should `display: flex` when `.carousel-mode` present

## Reference Implementations

### Default Configuration
- **action-card**: [reference/action-card.js](reference/action-card.js)
- **cards**: [reference/cards.js](reference/cards.js)

### Custom Configuration
- **tap-tiles**: [reference/tap-tiles.js](reference/tap-tiles.js) (custom thresholds, narrow items, no height equalization)

### Shared Code (see [reference/README.md](reference/README.md))
- **JavaScript**: [reference/carousel.js](reference/carousel.js) — in the app repo this file lives at `scripts/utility/carousel.js` and imports `debounce` from `shared.js` instead of `shared-debounce.js`
- **SCSS**: [reference/_carousel.scss](reference/_carousel.scss), [reference/_block-padding.scss](reference/_block-padding.scss)

## Summary

To implement carousel in any block:

1. **Import utilities**: `renderCarouselContainer`, `initializeCarousel`
2. **Render HTML**: Use `renderCarouselContainer(prefix, itemsHTML, options)` in `renderHTML()`
3. **Initialize**: Call `initializeCarousel(block, itemCount, options)` in `decorate()`
4. **Style**: Import shared carousel styles, add block-specific overrides
5. **Test**: Verify grid/carousel modes, navigation, accessibility, UE integration

**Key points**:
- Each `<li>` must have `carousel-item` class
- Padding goes on `.carousel-list-padding` (child), not `.carousel-list` (parent)
- Use `requestAnimationFrame()` before initializing
- Default thresholds work for most blocks (5/4/3/3/2/2)
- Default spans work for most blocks (3/4/4/5/10/10 columns)
- Customize thresholds/spans only when needed (e.g., narrower items)
